title: Ryan Nowicki Stewart (Pennant CEO, YC S26) — co-hosting the Corp Gov Tech Summit with Eric
summary: Stewart co-founded Pennant (YC S26), where he is CEO, and co-hosted the Corporate Governance Tech Summit in San Francisco, with Eric Ries and Evan Epstein among the governance voices there. He posted the invitation on the morning of the summit.
blockquote:
Full-circle doesn't begin to describe this one....industry colleagues from my roots in SF to home these days in NYC...old friends from and new faces.....communities like Council of Institutional Investors and Society for Corporate Governance I've followed and been part of for longer and bridging together newer ones in my chapter with Y Combinator...to startup legends and governance voices like Eric Ries and Evan Epstein.

We've got it all today! Come join us if you're in San Francisco.
attribution_title: Co-founder & CEO, Pennant (YC S26); Corporate Governance Tech Summit co-host
